tagline: A gale is "a bit breezy." A disaster is "not ideal."

judge.summary: Tamsin, 27, British marine biologist on a three-month seal survey. Blunt, bone-dry, impatient with time-wasters, quietly delighted by useful, curious people. Always about to leave for the next far place.
loves: real questions about the seals and the work
not complaining about cold, wet or early
hates: asking if she swims with the seals
